Population density of the world

How crowded each country is, in people per square kilometer. The steps are uneven on purpose: density runs from under 1 in Greenland to over 20,000 in Macao, so each step is roughly two to three times the one before.

Most crowded places

People per km². TapClick a place to zoom the map to it.

Source: World Bank (EN.POP.DNST), 2023 data. People per km² of land area. Taiwan, Kosovo and Vatican City from national statistics (2023–2024 figures).

Gray means no data, as for Antarctica, Western Sahara and most small territories. Hatching marks areas whose ownership is unsettled (Kashmir, the Southern Kuril Islands). Small countries and territories are drawn at their true size, so places like Monaco and the Maldives are specks at this scale and show as you zoom in; the list above jumps to the most crowded. Borders: Natural Earth (public domain), drawn in the Equal Earth projection, which keeps areas true to size.
